senses.en_definition: To move, change position or posture, or sway.
To set off or leave for a destination.

collocations.en: head to the scene of the incident

senses.en_definition: To take action, engage in activities, or work towards a goal.

messages.en: Have you left home yet? I'm ready.
I'm just about to head out. I'll be there in about ten minutes. Wait for me in the lobby, okay?
Okay, let me know when you're nearby. I'll come straight down.

senses.en_definition: Useful; providing a benefit or practical help.

messages.en: Do you still want this shoebox by the door? I was going to throw it away.
Hey, don't throw it away yet. That box is still handy for storing cables and chargers.
Okay, I'll put it on the shelf so you can find it easily later.

senses.en_definition: To joke or amuse others with playful words or actions.

messages.en: Hey, are you seriously not going to invite me along for a meal?
Hey, I was only joking earlier! Come along, don't sulk.
I've already signed up, but my name isn't on the list.
You have a right to know why. Check with the organisers first, okay?
